title: From Faulty Claims to Incorrect Patches: An Empirical Study of Task-Grounded Reasoning in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents increasingly resolve real-world software engineering tasks, yet still fail on many of them. Prior trajectory studies characterize these failures through task-agnostic patterns of agent behavior, such as repeated actions. However, an agent may follow a sound workflow yet act on a faulty understanding of the existing code, the task requirements, or a candidate fix. Reasoning models, which power most state-of-the-art coding agents, reveal this understanding in their native chain-of-thought (CoT), whose claims about the task can be checked against the facts. Yet it remains unclear how many such checkable claims the CoT contains, how many are faulty, and whether faulty claims actually cause incorrect patches. translated_title: 从错误论断到错误补丁：编码智能体中任务接地推理的实证研究
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体越来越多地能够解决真实的软件工程任务，但在许多任务上仍会失败。先前的轨迹研究通过与任务无关的智能体行为模式（例如重复执行的动作）来刻画这些失败。然而，智能体即使遵循了合理的工作流程，也可能基于对现有代码、任务需求或候选修复方案的错误理解来采取行动。驱动大多数最先进编码智能体的推理模型会在其原生思维链（CoT）中显露这种理解，其中关于任务的论断可以对照事实加以核查。然而，目前尚不清楚这类 CoT 中包含多少可核查的论断、其中有多少是错误的，以及错误论断是否真的会导致不正确的补丁。我们对这类论断——我们称之为“任务接地推理”——开展了首个实证研究，分析了四个开源权重推理模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上的 400 条轨迹。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文开展了首个针对编码智能体“任务接地推理”的实证研究，通过分析四个开源推理模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上的 400 条轨迹，量化其思维链中可核查论断里的错误论断，并检验错误论断是否会导致错误补丁。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of task-grounded reasoning in coding agents, analyzing 400 trajectories of four open-weight reasoning models on SWE-bench Pro to quantify faulty claims in their chain-of-thought and examine whether such faulty claims cause incorrect patches.
